name: 鄭麗珍
objective:
本課程教授人工智慧技術的基礎理論與實務技巧，並對於人工智慧在製造業、服務業、金融業的應用，提供啟發性的基本認知與創意，以激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、工業 4.0、人工智慧的製造業應用個案、人工智慧的服務業應用個案、人工智慧的金融應用個案。
This course aims to teach students the basic concepts and practical techniques of artificial intelligence and to introduce its applications on manufacturing, service, and finance industries. The course focuses on inspring students for innovative artificial intelligence applications. The course includes: artificial intelligence basics, machine learn-ing, big data, deep learning, generative adversarial network, entrepreneurial thoughts, design thinking, business models, artificial intelligence and modern technologies, industry 4.0, real case applications on manufacturing, service, finance industries.
schedule:
1. 人工智慧簡史
2. 人工智慧趨勢
3. 人工智慧與機器學習
4. 人工智慧與現代科技
5. 人工智慧的商業模式
6. 人工智慧個案研讀與討論
scorePolicy: 上課出席，上課參與，分組作業與報告
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）

name: 魏銪志
objective:
本課程的主旨在研討資訊管理的發展及新趨勢，內容包含資訊策略管理、資料庫管理、網路管理、電腦硬體技術、系統分析、軟體工程、管理資訊系統、決策支援系統、商業智慧、資訊倫理、資訊安全、知識管理、社會網絡等。
The focus of this course is on research and discussion of the developments and novel trends of information management. The topics include information strategy management, database management, network management, computer hardware developments, system analysis, software engineering, management information systems, decision support systems, business intelligence, information ethics, information security, knowledge management, social networks, and so forth.
schedule:
1. 數位韌性與組織韌性
2. 營運持續管理
scorePolicy:
上課出席 50%
上課參與 50%
consultation: 課程將透過北科 i 學園公告，課程問題請 Email: vickrey@mail.ntut.edu.tw
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
